title: Baaxô Qokolit
intro: kaxxa gibbatih uddur, yamixxige cankah tomcowwe mango baad manga, gadda gey kee rammitle aqayyaare. ta muucih safar ayfaf adda xer baritto ginook uwwayti ikoyta kee kaxxiini xalootu. ta roocih kinnaane reebisaanam kay aydaadi nek gubal yan ardil yunkuttube.
clues: Anu kaxxa farmoyti miraacissah tan ummattah fanat mannoowa.
Yalli yoh yeceem tannah tan fidin gaddaay, yi gaddih maftacitte mango maqar le maritteh kaxxa quukak sugte.
Yi-ummatta, yi-madda aaxaguk, Yalli yoh yeceemit akeera gicô baxi gorrisaanam kee addunyak liyo saami habbaale waytaamak, Yalli yoh abeh tan maqaane akah abannah yoo fayseenih.
Anu kaxxiina luk yeybeleeleqeh yok mango gadda dubuk inni ixxigaa kee macal geytem, ​​faxe yallih fayxi ganak.
Yallih maqaane cato akkek mamaxxaga taceem essere way, yi ikoyta dubuk yim kinniimil aamineh, kaxxiinitak cineh.
yok kaxxa kaxxiinaa kee zulmih xalootut, Yalli ardi fakka heeh yoo kee yi sigmah yanxuqeh amrise.
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
